question: Can transverse propeller loads, offset payload drag, or compliant two-riser suspension explain missing coupled dynamics?
scope: prior as-built HR and TL; same existing ten diagnostic windows; no coefficient fitting or promotion
propeller: in-plane force opposes transverse velocity at disk; scales with positive mapped thrust and axial/induced velocity; 9-inch diameter; no intrinsic disk moment
drag: same isotropic CdA moved +/-50mm fore/aft or vertically; includes local rotational velocity; replaces rather than duplicates original CG drag
risers: two axial tension-only springs/dampers replace point constraint and effective rotational springs; existing rotational damping retained; rest lengths fixed from each flight reference geometry with static preload
initialization: free suspension initialized to approximately support payload weight at observed attitudes; position/velocity correction enforces target line lengths and zero initial line speed; uncertain canopy state
decision: must match frequency/amplitude/phase and instantaneous rates across both flights; increased oscillation alone is not success
